description: If \(R(\bar x,i)\) is primitive recursive, then \(\exists i<b\ R(\bar x,i)\) is a primitive-recursive relation in \((\bar x,b)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.bounded_exists_primrec.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [Primcodable α]
  {R : α → ℕ → Prop} (hR : PrimrecRel R) : PrimrecRel fun x b => ∃ i < b, R x i
